Keyboard Diagnostics Guide

BC Elite Keyboard Tester Instructions:

  • Press physical keys on your keyboard to test switches and NKRO matrix response.
  • Each key turns into a highlighted Tested state after release.
  • Input Latency monitor measures the rolling average hardware response latency.
  • Supports all standard 104/108 ANSI keys, Function row, Navigation, Arrows, and Numpad.
  • Switch between RGB Rainbow Wave, Ice White, and Stealth Black themes anytime.
  • Click Reset All Keys to clear the audit results for a new testing pass.
